name: SAILORS
canonical: the pagan mariners of the Joppa ship, a knot of weather-beaten ancient Near-Eastern seamen with sun-blackened skin, wild salt-matted hair and beards, fear-stricken faces, wearing rough kilted tunics and sashes soaked through, ropes and amulets at their belts, terrified hands flinging cargo overboard and casting lots on the heaving deck of a small wooden Phoenician sailing vessel
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
